家計調査報告 1935–36

Kakei chōsa hōkoku (Report of the Household Budget Survey), 自昭和十年九月至昭和十一年八月 (September 1935 – August 1936)
內閣統計局 (Cabinet Bureau of Statistics), 東京; issued by 東京統計協會, September 1937 (昭和12年9月)

Every table is transcribed: the table of households allotted in the survey outline, the in-text tables of the summary of results, the statistical tables 第一表–第七表 (第五表–第七表 for the whole country and each of the ten cities), the tables in the survey regulations, and the classification of income and expenditure; the prose, the charts and the account-book forms are not. Each spread was read once by Claude Sonnet 5.5 from tight crops (Arabic figures). The national tables 第三表, 第四表 and 第六表 run over several spreads, each spread carrying half the columns or a block of rows: the pieces are joined into one table per printed table, with amounts (實數) and percentages (比例) as separate parts, and a check that no cell was lost or doubled. Decimal points printed as spaces, commas or colons are written as normal figures and noted. Where a digit was ambiguous only between 3 and 8 and exactly one reading made a printed total reconcile, that reading is used and noted; other doubtful digits are marked [?] even where a total would suggest a reading, and printed totals that do not add up are kept as printed and noted. The errata slip (正誤表, 30 corrections) pasted at the end of this copy is transcribed and each correction is attached as a note to its table; the figures themselves stay as printed. The bold total rows and the italic percentage blocks are often smudged, above all in the Kanazawa and Sendai expenditure tables. 115 of about 66,400 figures could not be read and are marked [?].
